SOC

是正計画

A documented set of actions designed to eliminate the root cause and effects of a security incident, restore affected systems, and reduce the risk of recurrence.

Definition

A documented set of actions designed to eliminate the root cause and effects of a security incident, restore affected systems, and reduce the risk of recurrence.

Operational example

The remediation plan outlined steps for patching vulnerable systems, revoking compromised credentials, and monitoring for reinfection.
